evidence_quotes: I made a few small changes... I didn't include the pimientos because I didn't have them, and I added smoked paprika because I love it.
I thought this dish was creamy and warm and perfect for a cold night. My family agrees.

benefit.description: Smoked paprika may add a smoky flavor to the dish.
